questions.scenario: Your group has to cook snacks for a massive school event. What is your role in the kitchen?

options.text: Figuring out how to multiply the recipe and set up an assembly line to cook 500 snacks fast.
Mixing random spices and ingredients together just to see what weird new flavor you can invent.
Making sure everyone washes their hands, the temperature is right, and no one gets burned.
Focusing on making a cool-looking, sweet-smelling snack that everyone will want to take pictures of.

questions.scenario: You are playing a sandbox video game like Minecraft. What do you spend most of your time doing?

options.text: Building massive, automatic farms and machines that harvest resources continuously.
Combining rare ores and weird potions to see if they make stronger armor or give new abilities.
Building a totally secure base with thick walls and traps so no monsters can ever get in.
Crafting colorful blocks, dyes, and banners to make your house look incredibly unique.

questions.scenario: You drop your phone and the screen shatters. What is your immediate thought?

options.text: Wondering how the factory mass-produces millions of these screens so cheaply.
Looking at the cracked glass and wondering exactly what chemicals make the screen work.
Regretting that you didn't buy a heavy-duty, shock-proof case to protect it.
Thinking about how to design a phone that looks beautiful but never breaks.

questions.scenario: You are buying a new winter jacket for a trip to the mountains. What do you check first?

options.text: The stitching and construction to see if it was manufactured efficiently to last a long time.
The tag, to see if it's made of cool advanced materials like Gore-Tex or thermal-reflective fabric.
If it is 100% waterproof, windproof, and has bright reflective strips for safety in the dark.
How soft the fabric feels on the inside and how stylish it looks when you wear it.

questions.scenario: You pick up a bottle of famous branded shampoo in the bathroom. What do you naturally do?

options.text: Imagine the giant factory machines filling thousands of these bottles every single hour.
Read the weird, long chemical names on the back to figure out what they actually do.
Check the label to make sure it says 'tear-free' and is dermatologically tested for safety.
Smell it to see if you like the unique 'Ocean Breeze' or 'Citrus' scent they created.

questions.scenario: Your school is organizing a Science Fair. What project do you choose?

options.text: A working water-filtration model that pumps and cleans dirty water continuously.
Testing which household liquids can melt ice the fastest or cause the coolest reactions.
A project showing how different fire extinguishers work to put out different chemical fires.
Making your own colorful, sweet-smelling soap or slime to give away to the judges.

questions.scenario: If you could instantly have a superpower, which one would you choose?

options.text: The ability to instantly make any slow, boring process 100 times faster and more efficient.
The ability to transform any material into something else (like turning lead into gold).
The ability to perfectly predict and prevent any accident before it happens.
The ability to instantly create the perfect everyday object or gadget for anyone's needs.

questions.scenario: You are packing a suitcase for a long trip. How do you handle it?

options.text: I figure out a geometric system to fit the absolute maximum amount of clothes into a tiny space.
I pack weird combinations of layers and tech-fabrics just in case the weather does something crazy.
I double-check the locks, zippers, and pack a massive first-aid kit just to be safe.
I carefully pick outfits that look great together and pack my favorite grooming products.

questions.scenario: When you order food at a fast-food restaurant, what secretly fascinates you?

options.text: How they manage to cook and serve hundreds of burgers an hour without the kitchen collapsing.
Wondering about the exact chemical reactions happening when the meat browns on the grill.
Checking if the place looks hygienic, the food is fully cooked, and the expiry dates are followed.
Enjoying the specific crunch, texture, and secret sauce flavor they designed for the burger.

questions.scenario: What kind of YouTube video are you most likely to watch at night?

options.text: A 'How it's Made' video showing massive factory machines producing thousands of items.
A crazy science channel mixing dangerous chemicals in a lab to see what happens.
Videos of crash tests or people pushing safety gear and materials to their absolute limits.
Videos of people making satisfying, aesthetic things like custom makeup, candy, or resin art.

Chemical_Process_Engineer.title: Chemical Process Engineer
Chemical_Process_Engineer.primary_match_text: You love efficiency, systems, and scale. You like figuring out how to make things work faster, better, and in massive quantities without breaking down.
Chemical_Process_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Designing massive factory systems that safely turn raw chemicals into thousands of gallons of fuel, medicine, or plastics every single day.
Chemical_Process_Engineer.alternative_match_text: Because you love optimizing systems and scaling things up, managing large-scale manufacturing operations is a fantastic backup plan.
Chemical_Process_Engineer.roadmap: Take PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Math) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, focusing on process design and plant operations.

Materials_Research_Scientist.title: Materials Research Scientist
Materials_Research_Scientist.primary_match_text: You are endlessly curious about what things are made of. You love experimenting, breaking things down, and discovering new, hidden properties.
Materials_Research_Scientist.day_in_the_life: Working in a high-tech lab to invent new materials, like a lighter metal for rockets, a flexible screen for phones, or a 100% biodegradable plastic.
Materials_Research_Scientist.alternative_match_text: If you love experimenting and discovery, becoming a research scientist or lab analyst is a highly rewarding alternative path.
Materials_Research_Scientist.roadmap: Take PCM in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Materials Science & Metallurgical Engineering, or a B.Sc in Chemistry followed by a Master's/Ph.D.

Quality_and_Safety_Engineer.title: Quality & Safety Engineer
Quality_and_Safety_Engineer.primary_match_text: You are careful, detail-oriented, and protective. You love following the rules, preventing disasters, and ensuring everything operates perfectly.
Quality_and_Safety_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Inspecting chemical plants, running purity tests on pharmaceuticals, and designing strict safety protocols to prevent toxic leaks or explosions.
Quality_and_Safety_Engineer.alternative_match_text: Since you are highly detail-oriented and care about rules, working as an environmental inspector or industrial quality control manager is a great fit.
Quality_and_Safety_Engineer.roadmap: Take PCM in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, followed by specialized certifications in Industrial Safety, Quality Assurance, or Environmental Engineering.

Product_Development_Engineer.title: Product Development Engineer
Product_Development_Engineer.primary_match_text: You are creative and deeply focused on the end-user. You love making things that people use every day, ensuring they look, feel, and smell perfect.
Product_Development_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Creating the perfect chemical formula for a popular new shampoo, formulating a longer-lasting lipstick, or inventing a crunchier snack food in a lab.
Product_Development_Engineer.alternative_match_text: With your creative mindset and focus on the consumer experience, formulating cosmetics, perfumes, or food products is a highly fun and lucrative option.
Product_Development_Engineer.roadmap: Take PCM or PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Chemical Engineering or a degree in Applied Chemistry, specializing in Cosmetics or Food Technology.
